aggregate.committed_prediction: twin UNDER-resolves the pyro regime; under-predicts pyro response
aggregate.interpretation: Median 99.9% of real pyro-NSD acceleration energy lies ABOVE the twin's ~152 Hz validated modal band (median 95%-energy frequency = 81680 Hz, peak-PSD freq = 3784 Hz). A modal twin truncated near 152 Hz therefore cannot resolve the regime, confirming the runner's committed DIRECTION (under-resolves / under-predicts). Magnitude is not graded: only a direction was committed.
